title: Grilled Lemon Herb Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper for 15 minutes.
Grill chicken for 6 to 8 minutes on each side until fully cooked.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, and cornstarch in a small bowl to make the sauce.
Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat with a splash of oil.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and carrots; stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until thickened and glossy.
